## Summary

Explain the problem and the change.

## Type of change

- [ ] Simulation behaviour
- [ ] Data preparation
- [ ] Optimisation or sensitivity analysis
- [ ] Dashboard or visualisation
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Tests, CI or maintenance

## Validation

- [ ] `ruff check src tests scripts` passes
- [ ] `pytest --cov=healthcare_des --cov-report=term-missing` passes
- [ ] New behaviour has deterministic tests
- [ ] Configuration, seeds and data sources are documented

## Research and data integrity

- [ ] No confidential or patient-identifiable data is included
- [ ] External datasets and methods are cited
- [ ] Illustrative results are clearly distinguished from reproduced findings
- [ ] Assumptions and limitations are described

## Results

Include relevant metrics, tables or screenshots. Do not include sensitive information.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and backwards compatibility has been considered
- [ ] Documentation has been updated
- [ ] Commit messages describe the implemented changes
